question: Which, if any, of the three source-complete unclosed Duskblade structural options has uniquely sufficient robust policy capacity, exact inactivity, viability and separate Scoreline and Afterimage support to justify one identity-only primitive preflight?

trace.selectionRule: Read the complete sole 256-row co-hand-telemetry explicit-null arm. No row, policy or seed is selected by an endpoint.

cohort.identity: Every option and both package anchors reuse the exact same identity-proved current-main policy and seed rectangle. No simulator executes and no identity is added, removed, replaced or reprioritised.

catalogueBoundary.construction: The catalogue is the source-complete difference between current-main combat effects and the closed Ward, Kindle, carrier, trigger, Shatter, vulnerable/execute, one-bit action and action-economy families. It retains only three distinct state couplings whose complete current card substrates are directly observable in the frozen trace.

excludedAliases.facetShatterEmber: Closed by the current native-grammar and subsequent acquisition evidence.
excludedAliases.vulnerableExecute: Weak-mend changes only an existing defensive debuff after healing; it adds no conditional damage, execute, vulnerable, Facet or Scoreline effect.
excludedAliases.wardAfterimage: No option reads or changes Ward, block, Afterimage, Warden's Edge or a defensive damage reflection.
excludedAliases.oneBitActionGrammar: No option is a Power, draw, Energy or cycle bit that modifies the next Attack. Generic card-type alternation is excluded rather than screened.
excludedAliases.carrierAndAcquisition: The current Duskblade starter Emberheart is the fixed guaranteed carrier for any later primitive. No offer, reward score, rarity, shop, event or policy-acquisition factor is introduced.
excludedAliases.ashHandSize: Repeated-hit is restricted to authored dmg effects with times greater than one. Phantom Blades is excluded because its hand-size multiplier belongs to the admitted Ash hand-size package, not this Dusk catalogue.
excludedAliases.fightQualityAndVictory: No option reads a victory, perfect-fight, elite, turn-count, encounter-kind or HP threshold trigger.

catalogueBoundary.cap: These three options are evaluated once. A failure does not permit a card subset, order reversal, threshold variant, alternative payoff, added carrier or further Cartesian catalogue.

options.rowOpportunity: Within one fight, Blood for Oil is played before a later current card whose authored effect can heal the player in combat.
options.stateRepresentation: A source=self HP-loss mark followed by a successful in-combat heal.
options.smallestPrimitiveIfSelected: With Emberheart, the next successful in-combat heal after source=self HP loss restores one additional HP and clears the mark.
options.claimBoundary: The play sequence is a permissive capacity upper bound. It does not prove self damage survived, healing occurred or the primitive activated.

options.rowOpportunity: Within one fight, a current Weak-applying card is played before a later current card whose authored effect can heal the player in combat.
options.stateRepresentation: Existing enemy Weak plus a later successful in-combat heal; no new persistent state is required.
options.smallestPrimitiveIfSelected: With Emberheart, each successful in-combat heal adds exactly one Weak to every living enemy that is already Weak.
options.claimBoundary: The play sequence is a permissive capacity upper bound. It does not prove Weak remained present, healing occurred or the primitive activated.

options.rowOpportunity: Within one fight, a current card whose authored effect can heal is played before a later Attack with an authored dmg times value greater than one.
options.stateRepresentation: A successful in-combat heal primes one later explicit repeated-hit Attack.
options.smallestPrimitiveIfSelected: With Emberheart, a successful in-combat heal adds one damage to each authored hit of the next repeated-hit Attack, then clears the mark.
options.claimBoundary: The play sequence is a permissive capacity upper bound. It does not prove healing occurred or a primed Attack was legal and selected.

design.type: zero-row mechanism-blocked competing-options audit; not a factorial, causal contrast, candidate optimisation or payoff search

matrix.observation: simultaneous Ward and Warden's Edge co-hand

design.sharedAnchor: All blocks are repeated deterministic observations on the same complete current-main trace, policies, seeds, baseline, estimator and stop rule.
design.noCartesianExpansion: No factor is varied and no joint cell exists. The same cached rows are read once; rows are not spent to complete a product.

scorelinePayoff.status: Separate fixed causal factor; not varied or estimated.

afterimagePayoff.status: Separate fixed causal factor; not varied or estimated.

acquisitionPriority.status: Fixed exact reward and shop policy; Emberheart is already the Duskblade starter relic.

structuralOption.status: Three frozen necessary-condition observations, not implemented causal factors.

scoreline.definition: A robust policy plays Chisel before a later Faultline in one fight in at least two of four frozen rows.
scoreline.status: Separate overlap anchor only; no Scoreline payoff or interaction is estimated.

afterimage.definition: A robust policy simultaneously holds Ward and Warden's Edge in at least two of four frozen rows.
afterimage.status: Separate conservative overlap anchor only; no Ward order, Afterimage payoff or interaction is estimated.

interactionsAndAliases.notEstimated: No interaction or causal effect is estimated. Candidate-only, anchor-only and Jaccard counts are shared-anchor decision-value screens, not interaction coefficients.
interactionsAndAliases.opportunityAlias: Ordered card play establishes only an upper bound. Current telemetry does not identify successful healing, surviving Weak, source=self damage or enabled primitive activation.
interactionsAndAliases.selectionRule: Exactly one option must pass every frozen gate. No ranking, weighted score, tie-break, model fit or qualitative preference may choose among zero or multiple eligible options.
interactionsAndAliases.nextEvidence: A uniquely eligible option may receive one separately preregistered exact-null and focused-mediator identity preflight. It receives no causal row, payoff claim or product authority from this audit.

estimands.primary: For each frozen option, the exact robust potential-active, exact-inactive, ambiguous and viable policy counts.
estimands.sourceBreadth: Exact distinct producer cards, consumer cards and ordered source-card pairs observed anywhere in the complete trace.
estimands.separation: Candidate-only, anchor-only, cross-active and Jaccard counts against Scoreline and Afterimage separately.
estimands.reliability: Exact stall or error row count.
estimands.notEstimated: No actual heal, Weak extension, self-loss mark, repeated-hit bonus, causal effect, complementarity, acquisition effect, payoff, detector result, RandomBuild movement, duration, product balance, ML, RL or optimisation endpoint is estimated.

gates.provenance: The 16-policy support and inactivity minima, eight-policy viability and separate-anchor minima, 0.55 overlap ceiling and one-fault ceiling reuse the existing frozen 64-policy capacity scale without result-dependent weakening.

factorDisposition.candidate: None is implemented, simulated or promoted. The smallest primitive text belongs only to its frozen option and becomes preflight scope only after unique eligibility.
factorDisposition.payoffs: Scoreline and Afterimage remain separate, fixed and absent at current-main research-payoff levels.
factorDisposition.additionalMethod: No ML, RL, optimiser, fitted model or policy mapping is used or authorised. This audit cannot authorise one because it does not observe legal-action or policy-selection causation.
factorDisposition.protectedSeeds: Acceptance seeds 3000-5199 and reserve seeds 5200-5399 remain unused.

executionAndStopping.construction: Deterministic Python verifies every frozen source, helper, evidence and cache identity; derives the complete card sets from current source; maps the full plan to output; evaluates all three options and both anchors once; and owns the unique-pass decision.
executionAndStopping.firstLook: The complete 64-policy by four-seed cached trace is the only look. No simulator, row, repair, subset, threshold, reverse order, new option or rerun exists.
executionAndStopping.successStop: Stop only when exactly one option passes every gate within 30 seconds.
executionAndStopping.futilityStop: Stop and close this catalogue when no option passes every gate.
executionAndStopping.inconclusiveStop: Stop at the cap if more than one option passes, any frozen input is unavailable or the exact decision exceeds 30 seconds.

decisionRules.success: Exactly one option passes every frozen gate and all immutable-input, trace, source and ledger checks pass within 30 seconds.
decisionRules.successAuthority: Apply decision boundary 1 and freeze only the uniquely eligible smallest primitive for one separately preregistered exact-null and focused-mediator identity preflight. Do not add a causal row, payoff level, acquisition knob, policy mapping, ML, RL, optimiser or protected seed.
decisionRules.futility: No option passes every frozen gate at the complete cohort.
decisionRules.futilityAuthority: Apply decision boundary 2 and close this complete competing-option catalogue at the preregistered cap. Continue inside issue #421 only from a different evidence-backed structural mechanism; do not subset a card set, reverse order, add a payoff, carrier or threshold, or repeat this catalogue.
decisionRules.inconclusive: More than one option passes or an exact decision is unavailable at the cap.
decisionRules.inconclusiveAuthority: Apply decision boundary 3 and record the competing-option result inconclusive at the cap. Do not rank, tie-break, add a row, modify an option, choose a candidate, add a method or use protected seeds.
